title: 第11章 先天斩第12章 八方来客
slug: 寻仙启示录第204章有区别吗
content_zh:
慕容仙儿惊魂未定的看着昏睡的左丘辰，她不相信世上有那种体质的存在，但事实摆在眼前。
但由于左丘辰没入灵，她也不好下定论，心想要么是那个环节出了问题，要么就是等左丘辰入灵后才能考证，对，入灵！
还要看看此人为何无法入灵，于是乎慕容仙儿再次进入左丘辰神魂查探。
慕容仙儿渐渐神魂离体与之相融，但是下一刻她却呆住了。
因为她发现左丘辰魂海被重创，慕容仙儿尝试去寻找魂海被重创的源头，可是此时白光乍现，一记斩刀悬挂在魂海上方。
现实中那倾国倾城的脸上也是布满了紧张的神色...同时嘴中喃昵道：“怎么可能，先天斩！”
屋内慕容仙儿额头更是布满汗珠，尽管如此，她还是压抑不住心中的震惊...
漫天星辰转动，神魂在银河游动，依旧，星光聚拢他身。
少年眼带喜意，握手玩弄点点星光，已然沉醉在其中。
“不要，那是时间的攻伐，是改变规则跨越时点的光粒。”
慕容仙儿嘶声大吼，但是银河中的少年没有被其惊醒，相反还无比快乐的翻腾...
一如既往的向前，汇聚无数光点的左丘辰大笑，手中的光点变幻成刀或剑舞动，他很满意这个感觉，或者是现在这个状态。
“完了，先天斩为何会出现在这个大陆？”
慕容仙儿惊愕，心底的震惊比表情更甚，从小到大，在族中听闻了许多攻伐之术，甚至许多禁术，那些都是传言，不管在族内，还是在各域中，都是万年难得一见。
但是万万没想到，在这个偏远的，灵力稀薄的九州大陆居然出现了传说中的“先天斩！”
黑暗的世界内，星空转动，下方的少年玩得不亦乐乎，丝毫未察觉危险来临。
所有星辰被吸取点点光芒，最后居然化为黑气，黑暗一角，那个似刀似剑的模样渐渐形成。
这次居然是一杆黑色长枪，无声无息，没有太多花样凝成。
“空间之术，抽取日月星辰之力，推算时间之势，斩未现之物！”
“这是超越了圣者的先天斩！”

慕容仙儿张大嘴巴，眼前的一切甚至颠覆了她的认知。
所谓先天斩就是推演时间，拿捏时空规则，把握空间之力，于天地之间，取天地精华，久而久之慢慢形成一道杀身要术。
这是灵术中最狠的之一，完全就是靠着推演，准确无误的诛杀未出世的某物。
而且此术习得最低品阶也是圣者，想到这里慕容仙儿心底一凉。
“先天斩如阵如术，时间越久，那么攻伐之力越大...”
而现在黑暗世界内，那先天斩的威势居然暗淡些许，这让慕容仙儿无比纳闷，同时也好奇左丘辰的身份。
黑暗世界内，所有星辰光芒消失，星光离体，左丘辰坠入银河，黑色长枪在黑暗中消失不见，下一刻赫然出现在左丘辰眉心处。
“折...仙...指！”
黑暗一边模糊的身影大喝，艰难的握紧食指和中指，指尖光芒照耀整个黑暗世界。
一指而去，如同彗星般闪耀，光芒所到之处黑暗毁灭。
“咚！”
巨大声响传来，左丘辰震飞，慕容仙儿也反震之力震退。
“噗。”
一口鲜血喷出，白色身影倒退，现实的房内内，白色身影也是口吐鲜血，身体弹射而出，震碎桌椅，直接被弹出房屋之外...
“我又救了你一命，若是你再不醒来，下次先天斩我也无能为力！”
content_en:
Murong Xianer looked at the sleeping Zuo Qiuchen in shock. She didn't believe that someone with that kind of physique existed in the world, but the facts were before her eyes.
But since Zuo Qiuchen had not entered the spirit, she could not make a conclusion. She thought that either there was something wrong with that link, or she could only wait until Zuo Qiuchen entered the spirit to verify it. Yes, he entered the spirit!
She also wanted to see why this person couldn't enter the spirit, so Murong Xianer entered Zuo Qiuchen's soul again to investigate.
Murong Xian'er gradually left her body and merged with her, but the next moment she was stunned.
Because she discovered that Zuoqiu Chen's soul sea was severely damaged, Murong Xianer tried to find the source of the soul sea's severe damage, but at this moment a white light suddenly appeared, and a slashing knife hung above the soul sea.
In reality, the Qingguo Qingcheng's face was also full of nervousness... At the same time, he murmured: "How is it possible, Xiantian Kill!"
In the room, Murong Xian'er's forehead was even covered with beads of sweat. Despite this, she still couldn't suppress the shock in her heart...
The stars in the sky were turning, and the soul was swimming in the Milky Way. Still, the starlight gathered around him.
The young man's eyes were filled with joy, he shook hands and played with the stars, already immersed in it.
"No, that's an attack of time, a particle of light that changes the rules across time."
Murong Xian'er roared loudly, but the boy in the galaxy was not awakened by it. On the contrary, he was writhing with great joy...
Moving forward as always, Zuo Qiuchen, who gathered countless light points, laughed, and the light points in his hand turned into a knife or a dancing sword. He was very satisfied with this feeling, or this current state.
"That's it. Why did Xiantian Zhan appear on this continent?"
Murong Xian'er was shocked, the shock in her heart was even worse than her expression. Growing up, she had heard about many offensive techniques and even many forbidden techniques in her clan. Those were just rumors. Whether within the clan or in other domains, they were rare to see in thousands of years.
But I never expected that in this remote Jiuzhou continent with weak spiritual power, the legendary "Xiantian Slash" would actually appear!
In the dark world, the stars were spinning, and the young man below was having a great time, unaware of the approaching danger.
All the stars absorbed a little bit of light, and finally turned into black energy. In the dark corner, the sword-like appearance gradually formed.
This time it was actually a black spear, silent and without much pattern.
"The art of space extracts the power of the sun, moon and stars, calculates the momentum of time, and kills things that have not yet appeared!"
"This is an innate slash that surpasses that of a saint!"
Murong Xianer opened her mouth wide, and what she saw in front of her even overturned her understanding.
The so-called Xiantian Slash means deducing time, grasping the rules of time and space, grasping the power of space, between heaven and earth, taking the essence of heaven and earth, and slowly forming a killing technique over time.
This is one of the most ruthless spiritual arts. It relies entirely on deduction to accurately kill something that has not yet been born.
Moreover, the lowest level to learn this technique is a saint. Thinking of this, Murong Xianer's heart felt cold.
"Innate cuts are like formations and techniques. The longer the time, the greater the power of the attack..."
But now in the dark world, the power of the Xiantian Slash was actually a little dim, which made Murong Xianer extremely puzzled and also curious about Zuo Qiuchen's identity.
In the dark world, all the stars' light disappeared, and the starlight separated from the body. Zuo Qiuchen fell into the Milky Way. The black spear disappeared in the darkness, and the next moment it suddenly appeared between Zuo Qiuchen's eyebrows.
"Zhe...xian...finger!"
The blurry figure on the dark side shouted, clenching his index and middle fingers with difficulty, and the light from his fingertips illuminated the entire dark world.
With one finger, it shines like a comet, causing darkness and destruction wherever the light reaches.
"Boom!"
A huge sound came, Zuo Qiuchen flew away, and Murong Xianer was also shaken back by the force of the shock.
"Pfft."
A mouthful of blood spurted out, and the white figure retreated. In the real room, the white figure also vomited blood, and his body was ejected, shattering the tables and chairs, and being ejected directly out of the house...
"I saved your life again, if you don't wake up, I can’t do anything to kill you next time! "
